definitions.downloads: Cumulative release-asset download counts reported by GitHub, not unique people or completed installations. Includes updates, repeats, automation and CI; no baseline deductions.
definitions.packageDownloads: EXE/MSI, DMG/PKG/mac ZIP, AppImage/DEB/RPM/Snap asset download counts; same file classification as traction.csv downloads_total.
definitions.updateMetadataDownloads: YML/YAML asset downloads. Repeated update checks and automation are included; not a lower bound on active installations.
definitions.audience: Verified installations and active users are not measured. Null means unavailable, not zero.
